thread:
incident-bot: PAGER: High 401 spike detected on auth-proxy (proxy-pool-3, us-west1). ~1.2k 401s/min. Possible debug log forwarder misconfigured; suspicious external S3 writes. Paging @oncall-alex :rotating_light:

oncall-alex: seeing it in the dashboards. 401s clustered by client-ip range 18.200.*.*. Some logged payloads include partial Authorization fragments. :eyes:

sre-liu: running quick query now — searching auth-proxy logs for `Authorization` and recent 200/401 events

sre-liu: ```
# logs snippet
logs.search("auth-proxy", "401", "Authorization")
# sample hit: Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGci...f3d
```

sec-jordan: if debug logs were forwarded externally we should assume tokens in logs may be exposed. Start key rotation plan and contain forwarder immediately.

eng-maya: I see a scheduled forwarder job `logshipper-forwarder-03` that recently pushed to s3://forwarder-public-2026. That bucket looks public.

cust-success-olga: alerted CS triage — customers reporting elevated 401s. Drafting short acknowledgement.

legal-amy: do not send customer-facing specifics until we confirm scope. preserve chain-of-custody for any objects.

oncall-alex: mitigation plan (ordered):
1) block offending IP range at edge WAF (18.200.0.0/16)
2) disable log forwarder job
3) rotate service tokens (svc-logshipper then svc-auth-proxy)
4) purge caches / force token invalidation where possible
5) prepare customer comms and legal review
Who can disable the job now?

sre-liu: I'm on it. scaling deployment down now: `kubectl scale deployment logshipper -n infra --replicas=0`

sre-liu: done — `logshipper-forwarder-03` scaled to 0. No new S3 PUTs in the last 30s. :white_check_mark:

sec-jordan: starting key rotation. Which identities? svc-logshipper first, then svc-auth-proxy. I'll coordinate with vault.

eng-maya: preparing vault rotation script and rollout for svc-auth-proxy. ETA ~8m to push new secret versions and update envs.

incident-bot: Incident created INC-2026-042. Severity: high. Bridge: https://call.redwood/INC-2026-042 (join for live mitigation). Pagerbot notified oncall.

cust-success-olga: comms draft posted: short note, we're investigating elevated auth errors, root cause under investigation, recommended temporary steps for users (re-login). Will attach to this thread.

legal-amy: acknowledged. keep me on updates. if PII or customer tokens present, escalate to compliance.

sre-liu: rotated svc-logshipper keys. New version in vault v: 12. Verified deployment secrets updated where applicable. No errors during rotation.

sre-liu: rotating svc-auth-proxy now. Triggering cache purge after rotation: `curl -X POST https://authproxy.internal/clear-cache`

eng-maya: cache purge confirmed for us-west1 and us-east1 clusters.

sre-liu: monitoring: 401 rate has dropped back to baseline. External S3 writes stopped. Still scanning for historical copies.

sec-jordan: forensic note — found 3 objects in `s3://forwarder-public-2026` created ~27 minutes ago. Downloading to secure forensics bucket and computing hashes. DO NOT SHARE contents outside sec/legal.

legal-amy: copy. ensure logs of access and download are kept. tag evidence.

cust-success-olga: customer impact summary: intermittent 401s for ~30 minutes, session invalidations observed; recommended customer action: re-authenticate. Holding on sending until sec/legal ok.

oncall-alex: good work. next actions: postmortem owner, timeline capture, and config guardrails to prevent public buckets from being targeted by forwarders. @eng-maya can you own the postmortem?

eng-maya: I'll own the postmortem. ETA 48h. Will include timeline, remediation, and follow-up tickets for guardrails + S3 policy linting.

incident-bot: Pager resolved (mitigated). Status: monitoring. Incident INC-2026-042 — mitigated; follow-up required: postmortem + customer comms pending sec/legal sign-off.

oncall-alex: locking thread for updates only. If anything new appears ping on the bridge. Thanks everyone. :heart:
